title: GC_GNN
summary: A collaboration repository extending HPDC'23 and ICS'23 autotuning work to explore whether GNN-derived embeddings can improve Gaussian-Copula-based configuration sampling for compiler/program autotuning. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, along with SDV metadata, conditional sampling, and constraints, to generate and resample tunable parameter configurations for benchmark templates.
evidence: gctla/mass_gc_sample.py:16-18 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, Condition and constructs samples for tuning experiments
